title: perinatal-ews state_race.json
description: Shape of results/2024/state_race.json, the pooled results by mother's race behind the explorer's state view. Written by scripts/build_explorer_data.py (--state-race) from the output of `perinatal-ews pooled`. Rates are proportions (0.105 = 10.5%). A rate, its interval and its counts are published only for reliable estimates (20 or more events, at least 2 years with data); every other estimate shows nulls and names what to report instead. tests/test_state_race_schema.py checks the published file and a file built from synthetic data against this schema.

previous_window.description: The previous, non-overlapping window each change is measured against; empty when no estimate was compared.

states.description: Two-letter state code to indicator to one entry per race group.

lo.description: Lower end of the 95% Wilson interval.

hi.description: Upper end of the 95% Wilson interval.

n.description: Events pooled over the years used.

births.description: Births pooled over the years used.

status.pattern: ^(reliable|suppressed \(<10 events\)|unreliable \(<[0-9]+ events\)|too few years with data \(<[0-9]+\))$

report.description: What to report: the group itself when reliable, otherwise the first reliable combined group it belongs to, otherwise "insufficient data".

years.description: Years with data in the window, comma-separated; empty when none.

combined.description: True for a combined group (for example Asian (combined)).

enum: not compared (an estimate is not reliable)
change.description: Change from the previous window: higher or lower when the 95% interval of the rate ratio excludes 1.

rr.description: Rate ratio, latest window ÷ previous window.

change.const: not compared (an estimate is not reliable)
